Connections

Sign in to Claude Code, Codex, claude.ai and ChatGPT with your own accounts, as usual. The office never sees your accounts: it only listens on this laptop, for what each tool tells it.

  • Claude Code
  • Codex
  • Chrome extension (claude.ai and ChatGPT)
Add the Chrome extension
  2. In Chrome, go to chrome://extensions (Chrome doesn't let a page open it) and turn on Developer mode, top right.
  3. Click Load unpacked and choose the extension folder.
  4. After installing or updating the Office app, click Reload on the Virtual Office extension once in chrome://extensions. Chrome requires this to load new extension files.
  5. Then open claude.ai or chatgpt.com. The extension reconnects automatically while Chrome is running; use Reconnect Chrome extension above to check it now.
Finish connecting Claude Code and Codex
  1. In Install below, select the hook options you use and click Save and install. A green Installed badge confirms each hook file.
  2. Start a new Claude Code session after installing its hooks.
  3. For Codex chats in VS Code, open Codex CLI in a terminal, type /hooks, and review and trust the Virtual Office hooks. Office can also read local command activity from a chat already in progress. If codex is not found in PowerShell, use this command:
& (Get-ChildItem "$env:USERPROFILE\.vscode\extensions\openai.chatgpt-*\bin\windows-x86_64\codex.exe" | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 1).FullName

Try QA: test activity in your current VS Code chat. Office reads local command activity as it appears; trusted hooks provide more complete tool events when Codex runs them.

Office

Shown at the top of the office and in its title.

Daily schedule

The office follows your working hours. Choose when lunch and the coffee break start and end.

Team

Seven built-in roles and two spare desks. Turn a member off to keep their settings while removing them from the office and routing. Custom members use their task keywords or an explicit name, such as @Team member 8: check this.

Install

Check what you want to install or update, then click Save and install. A green Installed badge shows hooks already saved on this laptop.

claude.ai and ChatGPT can use the same skills, but only if you upload them yourself:

  1. Save first, then click Download .zip under each team member.
  2. claude.ai: Settings → Capabilities → Skills → upload the .zip.
  3. ChatGPT: Skills → Create → Upload from your computer. (Depends on your ChatGPT plan; a work account's admin can turn it off.)

Update the app

Choose a newer VirtualOfficeSetup.exe. Your settings and edited skills are kept.

Uninstall the app

Opens the Windows uninstaller. It asks what to remove and whether to keep your settings.
